projectDescription: Acme Corp-6's AWS migration project aims to exit their on-premises data center within 18 months, optimizing license costs as a critical requirement. The migration will follow a 3-year roadmap, with a focus on modernizing workloads as much as possible during the initial 18-month period. The target region is us-east-1, leveraging a variety of AWS services to achieve the client's goals. This will include infrastructure-as-code, containerization, and serverless computing where applicable, to drive cost optimization and operational efficiency.
